title: Environment root marker
description: `<root>/.claude/exchange.json`. Its presence is what makes a directory a root; its contents are the config that used to be hardcoded in four scripts. Written by `exchange init`, edited by hand thereafter, and never travels with the plugin - this file is the whole reason the plugin can name no paths.

name.description: Display name for this root, used in injected context so a session can tell which exchange it is looking at.

stale_days.description: A claim or handoff older than this is flagged rather than hidden. A row that reads as current and is ten days old is worse than no row.

max_focus_chars.description: Truncation cap for a claim's focus line. The ledger this replaces had single rows of 23 KB injected into every session.

max_hot_paths.description: How many entries of each claimed list - repos, paths, tickets - to render per session. Anything beyond the cap is counted, never silently dropped. The key keeps its original name because renaming it would break every marker already written.

max_handoffs_listed.description: How many matching handoffs to render. Anything beyond the cap is counted, never silently dropped.

labels.description: Optional display-only grouping: root-relative directory to human-readable label. Never a matching key. A hand-typed label having to agree with a hand-typed label elsewhere is the defect class this design removes, so nothing is ever addressed or matched by these.
